imp.ok: ✓ Imported: {owners} owners, {props} properties (as drafts) and {leads} leads in the portfolio.

informes.medianaNota: Median over {n} answered leads: an average is warped by one late case.
informes.periodo: Last {dias} days, against the {dias} before them.
informes.pie: Only what these rows can know is calculated. Viewings, commission and per-agent performance are absent because this report does not compute them yet.
informes.sinDatos: No leads in this period yet.
lead.asignadoError: Could not change the agent for {nombre}: {error}
lead.faltaContacto: A phone or an email is needed: without one of the two there is no way to answer them.
lead.notaError: Could not save the note for {nombre}. Try again.
lead.nuevoAyuda: What you just took on the phone, before it slips away.
lead.sinResultados: No lead matches that search or filter.
lead.vacio: No leads yet. Create the first one with New, or wait for the website form.
list.error: The list could not be loaded: {error}
plantillas.buscar: Search by key, name or text
plantillas.campo.variablesAyuda: Type a name and press Enter. In the text it is written {ejemplo}.
plantillas.editarAyuda: The key and the channel stay put: the assistant and the chassis call a template by its key. Saving makes this template version {n}.
plantillas.enviar.aviso.borrador: This template is a {estado}: the text you see is the one the client will read.
plantillas.enviar.aviso.ventana: Twilio has this template as "{estado}", but the client wrote in the last 24 h: it goes out as a normal message.
plantillas.enviar.ayuda: It goes out in {idioma}, this record’s language. Below is the resolved text.
plantillas.enviar.bloqueo.retirada: This template is retired and will not be sent. Pick another one, or put it back in draft from Settings → Templates.
plantillas.enviar.bloqueo.twilio: Twilio has this template as "{estado}" and the client has not written in the last 24 h, so WhatsApp would not let it out. Pick an approved one, or wait for the client to write.
plantillas.enviar.faltaVariable: The "{nombre}" value is missing. Fill it in and send again.
plantillas.enviar.seguimiento: Tracking shows up in the record’s history.
plantillas.enviar.sinCanal: This record has no phone and no email: there is nowhere to send it.
plantillas.enviar.variablesAyuda: Taken from the record when the name matches. You can change them before sending.
plantillas.enviar.via: As {via}. Tracking shows up in the record’s history.
plantillas.enviar.via.free_text: a normal message, inside the 24 h window
plantillas.errorDistintas: The two languages use different variables: {es} in Spanish, {en} in English. They have to match.
plantillas.errorFaltaCuerpo: Both texts are needed, the Spanish one and the English one.
plantillas.errorNoDeclarada: The {idioma} text uses {variables}, which is not in the variable list. Add it below or take it out of the text.
plantillas.errorVariableNombre: "{nombre}" is not a valid variable: lowercase letters, digits and underscore only.
plantillas.intro: The messages the CRM and the assistant send, in Spanish and English. Edit them here; every save creates a new version, and each delivery records which one went out.
plantillas.sinResultados: No template matches. Try another word or clear the filters.
plantillas.twilio.ayuda: More than 24 h after the client last wrote, WhatsApp only lets Twilio-approved templates out. The platform submits them for approval; here you read how they are doing.
plantillas.twilio.cambiada: You changed the text: what Twilio approved is still the previous one.
plantillas.vacio: No templates yet. The platform seeds them along with the website; if this stays empty, tell whoever maintains the app.
